normalize() { sed \"s/test11_executable/test11.mjs/g\"; }
compare_case() {
  local node_out exe_out node_status exe_status
  node_out="'$(mktemp)
  exe_out=$(mktemp)
  if node /output/test11.mjs "$@" >"$node_out" 2>&1; then node_status=0; else node_status=$?; fi
  if /workspace/dataset/test11_executable "$@" >"$exe_out" 2>&1; then exe_status=0; else exe_status=$?; fi
  [ "$node_status" -eq "$exe_status" ] || return 1
  diff -u <(normalize <"$node_out") <(normalize <"$exe_out")
}

compare_case --a=1_0 --b=2
compare_case --a --help --b 1
compare_case --c 1 --help

'"'"
